Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel render on a plain light background, no characters or animals. Two views side by side of the SAME complete 40-block-wide, 36-block-deep French-country farmstead, same scale: LEFT straight-on north/front elevation, truly orthographic; RIGHT elevated northeast three-quarter view revealing east garden. Skilled human builder quality: substantial massing, recessed framed openings, projecting sills, actual stairs/slabs/trapdoors/fences/walls, stepped 45-degree roofs with eaves, verges and ridges. Two storeys, chimney top 14 blocks tall. Small clear view titles and a compact exact-id materials legend.
SITE: House on LEFT, potager on RIGHT, street at NORTH. House has rough mixed cobblestone, stone, andesite and a little mossy_cobblestone on cobblestone plinth; pale stone_bricks quoins, jambs, lintels and sills. Steep red clay-tile-looking gable roof built from bricks, brick_stairs and brick_slab (no invented terracotta stairs); ridge parallel to street, flared eaves. Tall 2x2 bricks chimney at ridge centre. Front three bays: shuttered windows either side of oak_door, stone step and two lantern posts; three smaller upper windows under eaves. Every window has open blue-green warped_trapdoor shutters. East lean-to porch: dark_oak_log posts, spruce_stairs sloping roof rising to house, hanging lanterns, dark_oak_fence rails, stair/slab bench and steps to gravel.
GARDEN: rough mixed house-stone wall with cobblestone_slab cap, stone_brick gate piers topped by lanterns and oak_fence_gate entry from porch. Symmetrical kitchen garden: two gravel paths with bricks centre lines cross at a stone_bricks well with four dark_oak_log posts, iron_chain and cauldron as bucket, little pyramid stair roof. Four raised beds edged in spruce_planks, each containing four orderly rows of ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots and a small water pool. Two rose_bush flowering arches over main path using wood fences and foliage. Espalier fruit trees against walls: oak_log trunks, fanned oak_leaves and flowering_azalea_leaves blossom. Sundial (smooth_stone_slab and oak_pressure_plate) and stone-looking urn (decorated_pot on stone pedestal) at opposite axis ends; dark_oak_fence lamp posts with lanterns at crossing. At garden rear: glass glasshouse with stepped glass roof and birch_log/birch_planks/birch_slab frame, low cold frame glass_pane on spruce plank frame, small spruce_planks tool shed with dark_oak_stairs gabled roof. Front low oak_fence picket fence, gravel path to door lined rose_bush, lilac and low oak_leaves hedge. Behind house oak apple orchard and spruce_log woodpile.

changes: Generated with the built-in image_gen tool and saved unchanged as concept.png in the current directory.
